Our Leadership Team

The experienced team driving Atlas Travel's mission to combine modern technology with high-touch personal service.

Meet Our Team

Elaine Osgood

Chief Executive Officer

As the leader of Atlas Travel & Technology Group, innovation and a spirit of unyielding enthusiasm are at the heart of Elaine’s success. With a bachelor’s degree in Education from the University of Massachusetts at Amherst and a master’s degree in Psychology from Anna Maria College, Elaine decided to employ her knowledge of people in an entrepreneurial venture. Purchasing a Uniglobe Travel franchise in 1986, Osgood achieved every franchisor award given, including Chairman’s Circle, President’s Award, Owner of the Year, #1 Agency in America and #2 in the World. In 1997, Osgood left the franchise world to lead her team into the global arena, then named Atlas Travel International, competing with the largest agencies.

A long-time active and involved member of the community, Osgood serves as a Corporator of Milford Regional Medical Center. As a Member of the Board of Directors for Girls Inc. of Worcester, Elaine is on the committee for Diversity and Inclusion and a mentor for the girls the non-profit organization works with. Elaine is also a Member of the Corridor Nine Area Chamber of Commerce, Marlborough Economic Development Corporation Board of Directors and the BCD Affiliate Board.

Elaine has been recognized as Ernst & Young’s Entrepreneur of the Year in New England. She has also been distinguished as a Top Business Builder in North America by Fast Company magazine, one of Travel Agent magazine’s 100 Most Powerful Women in Travel and was named to Inc. Magazine’s prestigious Inc. 5000 list. In 2022, Elaine was honored as WINiT by GBTA’s Outstanding Woman of the Year.

Lea Cahill

President

As a member of the Executive Team, Lea is responsible for leading the multi-national business operations, executing business strategy and ensuring operational excellence for all divisions of Atlas Travel & Technology Group (ATTG).

Prior to joining ATTG in April 2012, Lea directed corporate product definition & design for Amadeus North America, a leading global distribution software company that supports a wide range of travel products for airline, hotel and travel agency customers. In this role, she was instrumental in product management and development, solution concept to execution, as well as the innovative application of technologies.

From 1984-2009, Lea’s career evolved within a multi-national travel management company, where she experienced a 360-degree view of travel management, steadily increasing her responsibilities from intern to leading operations and, ultimately, travel technology in corporate, leisure and meetings management. As Vice President, Travel Technology & Operations, Lea was responsible for branch administration & operations, online booking & e-commerce, hotel & meeting solutions and training.

Earlier in her career, Lea worked with a variety of customer verticals ranging from defense contractors and pharmaceutical to investment banking and law firms. As a certified travel consultant and meeting professional, Lea led special teams supporting initiatives including presidential campaign, professional athletics, trade show and event travel.

A native of Massachusetts, Lea holds a degree in travel and tourism from Becker College and her meeting certification from Bentley University. She is a lifetime member and past Second Vice President of the Lowell General Hospital Auxiliary Board of Directors.

Andy Piggott

Chief Information Officer

As Chief Information Officer at Atlas Travel & Technology Group, Andy Piggott spearheads the digital transformation of one of the travel industry’s most innovative leaders.

Since joining the executive team in 2023, he has been instrumental in modernizing internal technology infrastructure and architecting customer-centric software solutions that redefine how travelers engage with Atlas.

With a career spanning over two decades at the intersection of technology, product innovation, and hypergrowth, Andy combines technical expertise with strategic vision to drive measurable business outcomes.

A seasoned executive, Andy has shaped the trajectory of global tech pioneers such as Oracle Cloud, Dyn (acquired by Oracle), and Rackspace. As founder and CEO of Incutio—a SaaS company acquired by Dyn—he honed his ability to scale disruptive technologies, a skill he later applied while leading cross-functional teams at Dyn to achieve $100M+ in annual recurring revenue. His tenure at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure saw him bridge cultural and technical gaps during critical integrations, while his role as Chief Product Officer at Section showcased his knack for aligning product roadmaps with emerging market demands, pioneering self-service channels that attracted thousands of new users.

Andy’s leadership extends beyond corporate walls. As a strategic advisor and board member for early-stage companies like Credmark and OpenRounds, he mentors teams to accelerate product-market fit and scale sustainably. His hands-on approach is rooted in a passion for software engineering—he holds a B.Sc. (Hons) in Software Engineering from Lancaster University—and a belief that empowering teams fosters innovation. This philosophy drove his success at Minim, where he transformed a startup into a Nasdaq-listed enterprise under the Motorola brand, slashing customer response times by 90% through strategic technology deployments.

Originally from the UK and now based in New Hampshire, Andy thrives at the nexus of technology and human potential. Whether advising startups, speaking at industry conferences, or staying hands-on with code, he remains committed to a singular goal: leveraging cutting-edge tools to create seamless, intelligent experiences. For Atlas, this means building a future where technology doesn’t just support travelers—it anticipates their needs and elevates every journey.

Leadership in action: When Andy isn’t reimagining travel tech, he’s exploring with his kids, hiking New England’s trails or mentoring the next generation of innovators, proving that the best leaders never stop exploring.

Rashi Gujral

Chief Financial Officer

Rashi Gujral serves as Atlas Travel and Technology Group’s Chief Financial Officer, where she oversees the company’s financial strategy and operations. A hands-on leader with a focus on automation and efficiency, Rashi is responsible for aligning the finance function with executive vision while implementing scalable processes to support long-term growth.

Prior to joining the leadership team, Rashi built a distinguished career operating finance functions from the ground up within high-growth technology and life sciences organizations. Most recently, she served as CFO for Velotix, an enterprise data governance and access control firm, where she owned end-to-end controllership, financial planning, and global operations. Her tenure provided deep operational experience, connecting high-level strategy with day-to-day execution. Prior to Velotix, she served as Director of Finance for LabMinds Inc., where she supported multiple successful fundraising rounds and managed complex project-based budgets across the UK and US. Earlier in her career, she held leadership roles at EUC Holdings and Medullan, Inc., and gained foundational experience in portfolio accounting at State Street Corporation.

Rashi earned both her MBA and her Bachelor of Science in Management and Finance (with a minor in Economics) from the University of Massachusetts Boston.

Based in Lexington, Massachusetts, Rashi enjoys spending her time away from the office with her husband and two boys. An avid cook, she enjoys preparing meals for family and friends, with butter chicken serving as her signature go-to recipe.

Dan McAuliffe

Vice President

As Atlas Travel & Technology Group’s Vice President, Dan McAuliffe is responsible for leading the product strategy and driving the implementation of innovative traveler technology.

Dan is an accomplished product and operations executive with a strong background in leading and scaling startups. His career gained significant momentum at Dyn, where he played a pivotal role in the company's growth and eventual acquisition by Oracle. At Dyn, Dan helped transform the company into a leader in the internet infrastructure space. Dan later transitioned to Oracle, where he took on senior leadership roles, contributing to the integration and expansion of Dyn’s technology within Oracle’s broader suite of services.

From there, Dan joined direct-to-consumer athletic footwear company, York Athletics Mfg, as Vice President of Operations, eventually becoming Chief Executive Officer in 2021. He then continued his career by advising other startups & eCommerce businesses.

Dan received his degree in Business Administration from the University of New Hampshire, with concentrations in Entrepreneurial Studies and Information Management Systems.

Simon Brown

General Manager, Atlas Travel & Technology LTD

Simon Brown, General Manager of our UK/EU division, has more than 40 years of success in the travel industry. Simon brings an in-depth knowledge of protocols and requirements for obtaining licensure and approvals to open a US-owned TMC division in the United Kingdom.

As General Manager of Atlas Travel & Technology LTD, Simon oversees the UK/EU operation and is responsible for its program management, in collaboration with the US-based Senior Director of Global Program Management. Simon is committed to ensuring that each of our esteemed clients receives the best possible experience when working with Atlas Travel, along with maximizing their company’s travel spend. A supportive leader, Simon ensures that his travel consultant team has all the tools and training required to safeguard our exceptional service and deliver cost savings to all customers.

During the entire span of his career, Simon has worked in London, earning an expansive breadth of experience, managing travel in diverse sectors for clients such as Swiss Bank Corporation, Unilever, Tate & Lyle, American Embassy, UK Foreign and Commonwealth Office, ITV Television, Channel 4 TV, Pathe Films and Momentum Pictures. Simon enjoys spending time travelling with his family, as well as playing squash and tennis. He is also an armchair football (soccer!) supporter, following Tottenham Hotspur.

Paul Swartz

Executive Vice President, Business Development

Paul Swartz joined Atlas Travel in November 2024 as our Executive Vice President, Business Development. With a rich career spanning over three decades, Paul brings extensive experience in business development across a variety of industries, including travel, finance, electronics, and real estate.

Before joining Atlas, Paul spent 15 years at American Airlines on the global sales team, where he held many roles including Regional Director. In these roles, he oversaw both corporate and agency sales teams, helping to drive revenue growth, enhance customer relationships, and expand the airline's footprint in key markets. His leadership in sales management and strategy has earned him a reputation for fostering high-performing teams and cultivating long-term client partnerships. Paul’s deep understanding of the travel industry and his ability to adapt to evolving market trends make him a perfect fit for his role at Atlas, where he is focused on accelerating the company's business development initiatives, growing our sales team, and enhancing our approach to new client acquisition and current client retention.

Paul is a New England native and holds degrees in Economics and History from Colby College.

Theresa Ryan

Vice President, Program Management

Theresa has been with Atlas Travel since 2012 and adds vast industry experience to our Leadership Team, excelling in creating and fostering exceptional customer relationships, strategic consulting and identifying innovative solutions for unique and complex requests. Theresa’s knowledge has been called upon for var­ious speaking engagements at industry events, including NEBTA, as well as BCD Travel affiliate meetings.

In her current role, Theresa is responsible for the success of the Program Management Team in providing top-of-the-line account management services for our clients. Additionally, Theresa works directly with our large market customer segment to continuously optimize their travel programs.

Prior to joining Atlas, Theresa has held many roles within the travel industry in both account management and front office operations.

Mimi Cleary

Vice President, Supplier Relations & Strategic Sourcing

Mimi leads Atlas Travel’s supplier relations and sourcing strategy, specializing in relationship management, contract negotiation and service delivery. She is responsible for developing and fostering partnerships with air, hotel, rental car, limousine and rail vendors throughout the travel industry.

After receiving her degree in Communications from Tulane University, Mimi started her career in travel and brings her 40 years of industry experience to Atlas Travel & Technology Group’s Executive Team.

Prior to coming to Atlas Travel in 2008, Mimi held positions as a seasoned travel advisor and in high-level management of agency operations. Mimi was hired by Atlas to first manage corporate operations before she was promoted to her current role. Her industry relationships and understanding of operational efficiencies continues to enhance Atlas Travel's reputation as a thought-leader in business travel product access and service excellence.

After growing up in the vibrant streets of New Orleans, Mimi is now based in the Boston area.

Cheri Lamont

Vice President, Front Office Operations

Since joining Atlas Travel as Director of Operations in 2014, Cheri has led front-end operations and has been responsible for managing all corporate travel advisor teams.

Cheri started her career in travel as a Travel Advisor after earning her bachelor’s degree from UMass Amherst, as well as a certification from The Travel School of America in Boston in 1991. Cheri’s work ethic and high level of service led to her quickly becoming a Branch Manager, Training Coordinator and eventually District Manager for other travel management companies.

Cheri blends her booking expertise, industry knowledge and ability to foster strong relationships to strategize and execute exceptional advisor booking experiences for our clients.

Sharon Sorensen

Vice President, Corporate Programs

Sharon has been with Atlas Travel since 2012 in both marketing and strategic roles. Her extensive knowledge of the corporate travel landscape spans nearly two decades and has made her a key driver of our program offerings and proposal processes. Sharon is responsible for managing and supporting the lifecycle of agreements for our customers and prospects within our portfolio, as well as evolving contracts to accommodate the ever-changing travel market. She is continuously seeking ways to identify new opportunities and implement improved efficiencies wherever possible.

Prior to her current position, Sharon held many different roles in the travel industry, including managing partner programs, steering multinational client expansion and providing support for all brand related initiatives including sales development, technology enhancements and acquisitions, internal and client communications, corporate events and marketing campaigns.

Sharon is an avid traveler and enjoys venturing to as many national parks as possible.

Leithia Warren

Vice President, Customer Success & Strategy

Leithia Warren serves as Atlas Travel and Technology Group’s Vice President of Customer Success & Strategy, where she oversees the customer lifecycle and retention strategy. A dedicated leader focused on building trust and driving results, Leithia is responsible for monitoring client health while implementing new systems and operational frameworks to optimize overall customer satisfaction and net revenue growth. Additionally, Leithia also leads the Initiatives and Deployment team, ensuring that custom client requests are seamlessly translated into strategic technical functions and successful implementations.

Prior to joining the leadership team, Leithia built a distinguished career operating across the travel and Software as a Service (SaaS) industries. Most recently, she spent five years with an enterprise SaaS organization, navigating complex change management, human resources, and training through a major asset sale and organizational transition. Before this, Leithia spent 30 years in the travel industry at both BCD Travel and another travel management company acquired by BCD. Leithia held numerous roles spanning operations, integrations, and implementations, culminating in oversight of online booking tool functions, mid-office automation, and client data solutions consulting.

Based in Texas, Leithia enjoys spending her time away from the office traveling and hosting lively family game nights. A passionate animal lover, she also loves spending time with her three French bulldogs.

Combining modern technology with high-touch personal service for over 40 years of global travel management.
